people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Er
people.line: Judah's firstborn son, killed by God for his wickedness.

people.name: Hamul
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah.

people.name: Perez

translations.web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
